name: Fey Wanderer
summary: A ranger touched by the Feywild who beguiles and confounds.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
features.short: Extra ranger spells you always know.
features.summary: You learn an additional spell at the listed ranger levels. They count as ranger spells for you but don't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.short: Once per turn per creature, +1d4 psychic (1d6 at 11th).
features.summary: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage, once per turn per creature. At 11th level this becomes 1d6.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.short: Add WIS to CHA checks; one social skill.
features.summary: Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). You gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.short: Advantage against charm and fear; redirect them to others.
features.summary: You have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. When you or a creature within 120 ft. succeeds on such a save, you can use your reaction to force another creature within 120 ft. to make a WIS save or be charmed or frightened by you for 1 minute.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.short: Cast Summon Fey once per long rest without a slot.
features.summary: You always know Summon Fey and can cast it once per long rest without a slot or material components, optionally without concentration (lasting 1 minute).

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.short: Cast Misty Step for free and bring an ally along.
features.summary: You can cast Misty Step without a slot WIS-modifier times per long rest, and bring one willing creature within 5 ft. with you.
